items.title: Nasdaq futures inch lower as Waller comments stall tech rebound; CPI in focus
items.summary: Investing.com - Nasdaq 100 futures pointed lower on Tuesday, weighed down by Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller’s comments supporting a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December, while investors awaited a key U.S. consumer inflation report that could provide some clues into the central bank’s monetary policy outlook.

items.title: 4 Overlooked Tech Stocks That Pay Dividends and Have Room to Grow
items.summary: Tech usually means buybacks and growth stories, not dividend checks. Four NASDAQ names, from an internet registry to a chip equipment giant, are about to pay out while barely touching their cash, and one carries a hidden catch.

items.title: Micron Soars 5% as TSMC Sticks to the “Global Logic IC” Industry, Not Memory
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron shares jumped 5% today after TSMC said it remains focused on logic chips, as Applied Materials and other chip stocks rebounded. TSMC staying out of memory removes Micron’s newest supply worry, though China’s CXMT is still pushing into server memory.
